[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Issnur Isles | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=486 }} The [[Issnur Isles]] is a stretch of lowlands covered with irrigated farmlands. A fishing village lies on the eastern side of the area and a [[corsair]]-infested ruined fort stands tall at the center. [[Skale]] prowl the watery areas and [[insect]]s and attacking [[plant]]s scurry over the dry patches of land. {{TOCright}} == Getting there == This area lies between the [[outpost]]s of [[Beknur Harbor]] and [[Kodlonu Hamlet]]. The only way to arrive here for the first time is exiting from Beknur Harbor. The primary quest [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]] leads through this location. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Corsair Bounty]]1 ** North of the ruined fort at the center. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Insect Hunt]]2 ** At the southeastern corner. ** Near the southwestern corner, before the slope. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Plant Hunt]]3 ** Southeast of the ruined fort at the center. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Skale Hunt]]4 ** East, at the exit into [[Kodlonu Hamlet]]. ** Northwest, at the exit into [[Beknur Harbor]]. ** Slightly north of the halfway point between the ruined fort and Kodlonu Hamlet. 1 In [[normal mode]], only for characters below [[level]] 17 with [[Sunspear rank]] below 6.
